A [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''female underdweller''' was working for the [[IT-3 Interrogator]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[It (IT-3 Interrogator)|"It"]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. When "It" and several other [[underdweller]]s brought a stolen [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] and the young [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawarrump]] to the [[secret Imperial detention center]] where the [[Gender/Legends|female]] was stationed, she was ultimately [[Skirmish in the secret Imperial detention center|knocked]] [[Sleep/Legends|unconscious]] by Lumpawarrump's [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].
